# Arazzo Specification & Ecosystem

> Official website and documentation hub for the OpenAPI Initiative Arazzo Specification — describing deterministic multi-step API workflows for humans and AI agents.

## Key Documentation

- [Arazzo Website](https://usearazzo.com/): Guides, examples, and tooling for the Arazzo Specification.
- [Website Repository](https://github.com/usearazzo/website): Source code and documentation content.

## AI Agent & Tooling Guidance

- Arazzo workflows define deterministic sequences of API calls with explicit inputs, outputs, and success criteria.
- Validated for /llms.txt agent ingestion via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
